title: The completed-coefficient inverse-limit functor and its derived projections
statement: Let $T$ be a scheme with the small pro-etale site, and let $R$ be a sheaf of commutative rings on that site. Use the module category $\operatorname{Mod}(R)$ and strict tower category $\operatorname{Tow}_R(T)=\operatorname{Fun}(\mathbf N_{\geq1}^{\mathrm{op}},\operatorname{Mod}(R))$ with exact evaluations $\operatorname{ev}_n$ of [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. Define $L_R:\operatorname{Tow}_R(T)\to\operatorname{Mod}(R)$ to be ordinary inverse limit, with its additive structure induced by preservation of binary products. On the derived categories of [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], define $\mathrm{Rlim}_R=\mathbf R L_R$, the total right derived functor of this actual inverse-limit functor, computed using K-injective resolutions of strict tower complexes. For each positive level $n$, define its projection natural transformation $\pi_n^D:\mathrm{Rlim}_R\to D(\operatorname{ev}_n)$ by applying the right-derived-natural-transformation construction to the ordinary limit projection $L_R\to\operatorname{ev}_n$ and composing with the canonical comparison $\mathbf R\operatorname{ev}_n\cong D(\operatorname{ev}_n)$ for exact evaluation. Lean indexes the positive level $n$ by $n-1\in\mathbf N$. These are the published constructions completedTowerLimit, coherenceTowerLimit_additive, completedRlim and completedRlimProjection; no triangulatedness, Roos-triangle or resolution-independence assertion is part of this definition.
